arStrings.szText:
Grants curated legendary items and a tempering manual from an archetype of your class.

{icon:bullet} Barbarian - Brawler
{icon:bullet} Rogue - Cutthroat
{icon:bullet} Druid - Storm
{icon:bullet} Sorcerer - Conjuration
{icon:bullet} Necromancer - Summoning
{icon:bullet} Spiritborn - Eagle
{icon:bullet} Paladin - Juggernaut
The path to Hell will be paved with the blood of demons. How they are to be slaughtered is yet to be written.
